verdict.rationale: The docs show some multi-item operations. The Resolve tool resolves conflicts for many files at once, and adding a directory imports all its files as a new repository. Shortcuts automation lets files and data flow between actions, Auto-Sync commits, pulls and pushes whenever changes are detected, and the Repository Agent can modify files and commit. However, there is no documented general multi-select or batch mode for files, commits or repositories. Missing for 10: explicit batch actions across many files, commits or repositories; documented looping or batch Shortcuts actions; independent hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
